Deep Blue Sushi is a fun sushi restaurant simulator where cooking is closely linked to ocean exploration. Instead of relying on traditional grocery deliveries, the restaurant's owners must forage for their own ingredients by embarking on underwater expeditions. The resulting catch becomes the basis for the menu, and successful operations gradually transform the small establishment into a large, busy restaurant.

From the depths to the kitchen

Before diving, you can select the right equipment for a specific task. Some tools help catch fish, while others are useful for exploring underwater areas or cleaning up messes. Rare species and unusual creatures lurk in the depths, so every foray can yield something new. Some ocean dwellers aren't looking to be prey and can seriously complicate the expedition.

Back on shore, the team switches to restaurant operations. Fresh ingredients are transformed into sushi according to recipes, and the growing number of orders requires a well-organized process. Earnings can be used to install additional tables, upgrade workstations, and expand the menu. The character itself can also be customized, changing clothing, hairstyles, colors, and accessories to give each team member a unique look.

Features of the game

Exploring different depths of the ocean. A large selection of marine life. Development of restaurant infrastructure. Customizing the character's appearance.
